name: Dynetwork Partner
author: Digipacket

sections.description:
Dynetwork Partner turns your WooCommerce store into a white-label storefront for web services. Products and wholesale-based prices are imported directly from your Dynetwork.net reseller account; you set your own selling prices and keep the margin.

Features

  • One-click catalog import: every service becomes a WooCommerce product (categories, billing cycles, specifications).
  • Domain search on your site ([dynetwork_domain_search]): availability, price, alternative extensions, 1–5 year terms, add to cart.
  • Plan grids ([dynetwork_plans]), TLD price lists ([dynetwork_domain_prices]), trending-domains banner ([dynetwork_trending_domains]).
  • Automatic provisioning on every paid order (domains, hosting), with a detailed report added as an order note.
  • “Domain name” field on hosting products (new domain with live availability check, or existing domain), billing-term selector, server add-ons (VPS), e-mail account quantity.
  • Reseller balance displayed in the admin, with a warning before provisioning would fail.
  • Per-product customization: fixed or dynamic price mode, overwrite-protection lock, Elementor-friendly editing.
  • Automatic renewal reminders: e-mails 7, 3 and 1 day(s) before expiry, on expiry day and after expiration (with a “Renew now” button), a dashboard under WooCommerce → Payment reminders, and customizable e-mail templates.
  • Full built-in documentation (Dynetwork menu → Documentation).

Requirements: a Dynetwork.net reseller account with API access (free sign-up available from the plugin).

The plugin interface is currently provided in French, as the service primarily targets French-speaking resellers. Translations can be contributed via translate.wordpress.org.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Dynetwork.net service (https://partnersite.dynetwork.net) to operate. The following data is transmitted to that service: the reseller API credentials entered in the settings, the domain-availability queries typed by visitors, and — on paid orders only — the order lines to provision together with the customer’s billing details (name, e-mail, address, phone), which are required to register services with the registry. No data is sent to any other third party.

Service provided by Dynetwork — terms and privacy: https://dynetwork.net/contact.php
sections.installation:
1. Plugins → Add New → Upload; install and activate the plugin (WooCommerce is required).
  2. Open the Dynetwork menu: allow the displayed IP address in your Dynetwork panel (Settings → API).
  3. Enter your e-mail, password, Reseller ID and API key, then click “Save & connect”.
  4. Click “Import services” and start selling.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Dynetwork.net account?

Yes. The “Create your account” link on the settings page opens the reseller sign-up form.

How is my margin calculated?

Your customer pays on your store at the price you set; the wholesale price is debited from your reseller balance when the service is provisioned. The difference is your margin.

Are my API credentials exposed?

No: they stay in your WordPress settings and are only transmitted, encrypted over HTTPS, to the Dynetwork.net server.

Is the plugin HPOS compatible?

Yes, compatibility with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage is declared and tested.

screenshots.caption: Storefront powered by shortcodes: live domain search, trending TLDs and a hosting plan grid on the reseller's own site.
Renewal reminders dashboard (WooCommerce → Payment reminders): subscriptions, expiry dates, filters, one-click reminders and customizable e-mail templates.
Plugin settings: reseller balance, imported services and connected account at a glance, with a simple connection form.
The plan grid shortcode works for any imported category — here Google Workspace, with live specifications and pricing.
WooCommerce cart with an imported hosting plan: domain, registration fee and billing term handled automatically.
